character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves
story_so_far: After escaping his captors and uncovering his engineered abilities, Kael infiltrated an offshore research platform. Following a betrayal by his scarred ally and a narrow escape from the facility's self-destruction, Kael has washed ashore on the mainland with decrypted coordinates, realizing a vast syndicate is hunting him and setting the stage for a relentless pursuit.
